bio.text: John Curran, a Republican, was sworn in to represent Illinois's 41st Senate District in July 2017, according to the General Assembly biography.
He was a DuPage County Board member from 2008 to 2017 and its vice chairman, and previously spent 19 years as an Assistant State's Attorney in the Cook County State's Attorney's Office.

Curran earned a law degree from Northern Illinois University College of Law and a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, and works as an attorney at a private law firm in Oak Brook.
He lives in Downers Grove, the biography says.
